name: vtx-track
description: Local-first, privacy-first time tracker for your whole machine — with deep VS Code granularity. Headless daemon, not Electron.
author: VTX Labs (https://vtxlabs.dev)

pnpm.//: better-sqlite3 is intentionally NOT built here: its install lifecycle gyp-compiles from source (needs a full C/C++ toolchain), which fails on toolchain-less machines (notably Windows CI without MSVC). The root postinstall (scripts/fetch-native.mjs) fetches the prebuilt binary instead, and the daemon self-heals at startup. esbuild ships pure prebuilt binaries and is safe to build.
